name: @tselect/github
description: Shared GitHub Actions workflows and CI scripts for the @tselect packages.
//: `type: module` is load-bearing, not housekeeping: the runner checks this repository out under _actions and Node decides a .ts file's module format from the nearest package.json. Without it, tsx loads scripts/ci/*.ts as CommonJS and every import fails.
//bin: `tselect` configures the seven package repos from config/. It runs on a laptop against the API, never on a runner, so unlike scripts/ci/ it is allowed a dependency.
